from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityFacultyData(BaseModel):
    """Faculty data extracted from one university's CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Count of full-time instructional faculty")
    part_time_instructional_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Count of part-time instructional faculty")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Academic year/period, e.g. '2021-2022' or 'Fall 2021'")
    section_reference: str | None = Field(description="CDS section where data was found, e.g. 'Section I-1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityFacultyData]
